headlines.title: Predicting intraday direction is closed
headlines.plain: Eight pre-registered tests and a 2.8-million-configuration sweep found no edge in calling QQQ/SPY direction intraday.

headlines.title: A backtest priced at the mid can have the wrong sign
headlines.plain: Selling 0DTE straddles looks like a strong edge at mid prices and loses money at the prices you can actually trade at.
headlines.number: t = +7.52 at mid, −5.38 at bid/ask, same 37,517 trades

headlines.title: One survivor, and it trades shares, not options
headlines.plain: A published intraday-momentum rule held up on 10 years of QQQ, but most of its profit comes from a handful of days.
headlines.number: +$3.34/trade, 2,905 trades, Holm p = 0.0043; 74% of P&L from the top 1%

headlines.title: Capping winners lost money every time it was measured
headlines.plain: A profit target raises the win rate and lowers the money, on three different datasets.
headlines.number: +25% target: 71.6% win rate, breakeven needs 75.3%; −1.17 bp and −0.72 bp on two breakout rules

headlines.title: The big model was a constant
headlines.plain: A 398,854-parameter TFT gave the same answer in a crash and in a flat market. It was replaced by a six-parameter volatility model that responds.
headlines.number: crash vs flat chop: 0.1 points apart on a 0–100 scale
